patches.reason: On the case-sensitive Linux filesystem, the supplied dataset is named CMSW_WB_final.dta while the do-file requested cmsw_wb_final. The working copy uses the exact packaged basename; the dataset bytes and analysis logic are unchanged.

The three source-supplied net install statements were commented in the working copy because the approved frozen Stata ado paths already contain winsor, outreg2 2.3.2 and psacalc, while attempt policy prohibits package installation and network access. All commands were mounted explicitly and resolved during the native run.

review_notes: The Stata 18 log reports that set matsize is ignored in modern Stata; the source setting was preserved. Fourteen authored poisson fits report Stata’s noncount-dependent-variable note, stating these results are exponential-mean models rather than a poisson model; the author specifications were preserved unchanged.

The approved log reader showed 9,037 lines of the author capture log with no withheld rows and 9,105 visible lines of the batch log; it withheld only three startup/license-context lines. The logs end with the do-file completion marker and runner receipt __AUTHOR_ANALYSIS_RC__ 0; no Stata r(#) error code was present. The runner receipt reports original_inputs_unchanged=true.

The author code invokes one sts graph and three lroc commands but has no graph export commands, so these displays were executed and reviewed in the native log but no persistent figure files were authored. Three ROC area outputs were logged.
The frozen outreg2 2.3.2 source was used to derive exact output names: extensionless using table3/table5 plus excel produces .txt and .xml files. No published-match claim is made.
